{{Short description|Chinese researcher}}
'''Long Yiming''' (born October 1948) is a Chinese [[mathematician]], and professor at [[Nankai University]]. He is a fellow of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Nankai University">{{cite web | title=Long Yiming | website=Nankai University | url=https://en.nankai.edu.cn/2020/1226/c22845a330559/page.htm | language=en | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref><ref name="Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences">{{cite web | title=Division of Mathematics and Physics---Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | url=http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | language=en | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref>

His research focuses on [[symplectic geometry]], [[nonlinear functional analysis]], [[celestial mechanics]], the [[variational method (quantum mechanics)|variation method]], and the [[Hamiltonian system]].<ref name="Nankai University"/>

He is a distinguished professor of the [[Changjiang Scholars Program]] and the Director-General of the [[Chinese Mathematical Society]].<ref name="Nankai University"/>

==Education==

Between 1978 and 1981, he was a student at [[Nankai University]], where he obtained a master's degree. Between August 1983 and December 1987, he was a student at the [[University of Wisconsin-Madison]], where he received a doctorate degree in mathematics.<ref name="Nankai University"/>
